evidence.snippet: It's easy to get one or more API keys for accessing your Podio data.
grab an API key for each app you want to build from your account settings page.

decisions.reason: Any developer can sign up for a free Podio account and immediately generate an API key from account settings with no payment or approval step mentioned.

evidence.snippet: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.
Before you can use the Podio API you must register your application . Your application is assigned a unique identifier, called "Client ID", together with a "Client Secret".

decisions.reason: Documentation explicitly and solely describes OAuth2 flows (server-side, client-side, username/password, app authentication) as the authentication mechanism.

evidence.snippet: MCP server exposing Podio API tools for integration with ChatGPT, Copilot Studio, and other MCP-compatible clients.

decisions.reason: The MCP server is hosted on the podio.com subdomain itself (mcp.podio.com), indicating it is vendor-published rather than third-party.
